title: PS5 Games on PC, No Emulator
description:
PS5 games on PC with no emulator: AnyPS5 rewrites a PS5 game into a native Windows program. The PS5's AMD processor already speaks x86-64, so the tool swaps in its own versions of Sony's system libraries. One game works so far (Dreaming Sarah: 60 FPS on a GTX 1050 Ti). 16,380 GitHub stars. Bring your own games, and download it only from GitHub.
